profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer II at Compass
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a MS in CS from Georgia Tech. Passionate about building and delivering scalable systems, leading cross-functional initiatives, and helping grow strong, effective engineering teams.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer II
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
Led high-impact initiatives across IAM, Compliance, Commissions, and Reporting systems, partnering with Product, Design, and stakeholders. Owned end-to-end delivery of complex, ambiguous projects with strong operational reliability. Led 3-6 engineers directly and influenced technical decisions across 15+ engineers spanning 3 teams.

Built scalable platform integrations and automation, reducing processing time from ~5 days to 1 day and decreasing budget overages by $2.1M. Drove operational excellence and cost optimization, leading initiatives that saved $82K annually and improved system reliability.

Mentored engineers and shaped system architecture, improving team effectiveness, code quality, and system reliability.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Designed, developed, deployed, and supported content understanding, A/B testing, and recommendations services.

Engineered digital content distribution services to deliver content from 15+ brands to the web, Google AMP, Apple News, MSN, Yahoo, and many other partners.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led the end-to-end design, development, and deployment of web and mobile applications in the collaboration and productivity spaces.

Conducted customer conversations and market research to help define and prioritize the feature roadmap.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description: Architected and developed prototypes and a minimum viable product. Conducted customer conversations and market research to help create and iterate an initial business model.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Developed key features for the BlackBerry mobile documents solution (Documents To Go) for Playbook and BB10 platforms.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher and Web Developer
positions.description:
Implemented algorithms in C++ to passively differentiate between 802.11 and 802.3 network traffic. Created Python scripts to evaluate and analyze the implementations.

Developed websites for the Engineering Diversity Program using HTML, JavaScript, PHP, and SQL.

educations.degreeName: Master of Science in Computer Science

projects.title: Introduction to Machine Learning with TensorFlow.js
projects.description: Introduction to TensorFlow.js by building a web app that is able to recognize hand drawn digits in a Canvas element.
